name: Shelley Maycraft
original_name: シェリー・メイクラフト
source: [url=/c9013]Leicester's[/url] young-looking mother and the wife of Nagan. Shelley is very outgoing andy, and particularly likes to tease Leicester. She is good friends with [url=/c9018]Chelsea[/url] due to their adventures, along with [url=/c9049]Nagan[/url] and [url=/c9052]Fabious[/url]. Nevertheless her carefree personality, usually whatever Shelley says has some kind of a deep meaning. Leicester's personality is greatly influenced from her upbringing.
